# appgatesdp_client_profile (Resource)

Supported SDP Admin API versions: v21, v22, v23, v24, v25.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity_provider_name` (String) Name of the Identity Provider to be used to authenticate.
- `name` (String) A name to identify the client profile. It will appear on the client UI.

### Optional

- `exported` (String) Exported time is the last time when the client profile is exported either using  the URL or Barcode.
- `hostname` (String) Overrides the Profile Hostname in global settings for this specific profile. Generated URLs will use this hostname instead.
- `id` (String) ID of the object.
- `notes` (String) Notes for the object. Used for documentation purposes.
- `spa_key_name` (String) SPA key name to be used in the profile. Same key names in different profiles will have the same SPA key. SPA key is used by the client to connect to the controllers. If left empty, the name will be generated by the controller using the profile name.
- `tags` (List of String) Array of tags.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Create date.
- `global_hostname` (String) The Global Profile Hostname as defined in global settings. Generated URLs will use this hostname.
- `read_only` (Boolean) Whether the entity is protected from manual updates and deletes. Supported in API versions: v24, v25.
- `updated` (String) Last update date.
